detail.longDescription: Hey HN! I'm Lakshay, and at Cerulion we cooked up a harness for physical AI. Built on top of our deterministic runtime, we now have MCP tools that let any LLM see and move a robot. It closes the loop with measurements so a model doesn't try to guess its way through the task, and imbues common sense and robotics best practices into the workflow. We ran the numbers on LIBERO-PRO and quite frankly are a bit shocked. Gemini 3.8 Flash with Cerulion solved 73 of 100 LIBERO-PRO tasks. GPT-6 Astra on a bare 3-tool baseline (arXiv:2610.30051) solved 71, at about 12x the cost and 3x the wall time per run. Flash on that same baseline solved 25. Guys. Gemini 3.8 Flash matched GPT-6 Astra for robotics. Model intelligence is not the bottleneck. A harness is all you need ;) Star us and follow along. Try the quickstart, lmk what you guys wanna see next. I'll post again soon! (teaser: my Nespresso machine is getting a lot of attention from my robot arm)
